description: Mother's Treasure Hari Mirch Achar, Spicy Green Chilli Pickle, 200 gm - Distributed/Packaged by Mother'S Treasure. Product Details: Mother's Treasure Hari Mirch Achar is a fiery and flavourful spicy green chilli pickle that brings the authentic taste of traditional Indian home-style pickling right to your table. Crafted with 62.8% fresh green chillies and a carefully selected blend of spices including mustard oil, fennel seeds, fenugreek seeds, turmeric powder, black salt, dried mango powder, cumin, Kashmiri Lal Mirch, nigella seeds, mustard seeds, and asafoetida, every bite delivers a bold and tangy punch that perfectly complements your everyday meals. This 200 gm jar is ideal for pairing with parathas, dal-rice, khichdi, or any Indian bread. Manufactured by RRSJM Food Products LLP, Kanpur, and carrying a valid FSSAI licence, this pickle is made with quality and care. Store in a cool, dry, and dark place away from direct sunlight, and ensure the lid is tightly closed after each use. A true treasure of traditional flavours!
